decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed off street parking layout is considered acceptable, the inclusion of soft landscaping ensures there would be no harm to the appearance of the area or the site itself, and the provision of two parking spaces within the forecourt is in accordance with the Council's parking policy and policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 5 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 29 Worton Way, Hounslow. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.
Condition : 6 - The hereby approved forecourt plan shall be implemented within 6 months of the date of approval.
description: Removal of Condition 6 of Planning Permission 01240/29/P1 to allow for 2 additional parking spaces to front garden of site and continued use of garage as habitable room.
